packages/checkpoint/src/install.ts.message: PowerShell treats U+2018–U+201B as quote delimiters, but only ASCII ' is rejected. A crafted checkout path can terminate the quote and inject commands into statusLine.command.
This replaces the target with a temp file using the default mode. A 0600 settings file can become 0644, exposing secrets in its env block; preserve the target mode.
Atomic rename replaces a symlinked settings.json with a regular file. Dotfile-managed settings lose their link, so future edits no longer reach the real config.

packages/checkpoint/src/state.ts.message: Any string is accepted for since despite the state-file contract requiring an ISO timestamp. Corrupt state is accepted and can break time-based transitions; validate it.
